第一卷 第25章 暮年再进炼气三层（第1页）
苏玄尘拿起一枚极品清风灵果，张口吞入腹中。
刹那间，清甜温润的药力瞬间化开，顺着经脉流转四肢百骸，浸润丹田灵海。
不同于赤血灵果专攻肉身气血滋补，清风灵果的药力，更擅长梳理经脉、净化灵力、洗去修行杂质。
丝丝缕缕精纯药力，缓缓冲刷他修行多日积攒的灵力底蕴。
此前秘境厮杀、妖兽对战、灵乳滋养积攒的所有残留驳杂之力，尽数被涤荡干净。
他的经脉被持续拓宽、加固、温润，原本因为暮年修行留下的细微紧绷感彻底消失。
丹田之内，天灵根灵力愈发纯粹、厚重、凝练。
一层一层稳步叠加，缓缓堆砌，从不狂躁冲击，只稳扎稳打打磨境界根基。
苏玄尘始终闭目凝神，稳守心神，控制药力流转速度。
暮年修仙，根基大于一切，境界可以慢，底蕴绝对不能虚浮。
他没有急功近利冲击突破，而是借着极品灵果的绝佳药力，一遍遍打磨全身经脉与灵力。
时间缓缓流逝，半个时辰悄然过去。
原本卡在炼气二层圆满许久的灵力壁垒，在极致纯净的药力滋养下，彻底松动、碎裂！
没有冲天灵光，没有异象外泄，没有半点突破动静。
所有气息被他牢牢锁在体内，外人无从察觉分毫。
唯有他自身清楚，此刻的自己，已然完成一次全方位蜕变。
经脉更宽、灵力更纯、肉身更稳、生机更盛。
周身萦绕百年的衰败死气，再度消散大半。
原本佝偻的脊背，肉眼难察地挺直些许，灰白发丝隐约透出淡淡光泽，浑浊眼眸彻底清亮，深邃沉静。
突破之后，他并未停下修行，继续稳坐山洞，花费整整一个时辰稳固全新境界。
将炼气三层初阶，硬生生打磨至圆满稳固，每一缕灵力都凝练到极致，无一丝虚浮破绽。
此番突破，带给苏玄尘的不仅仅是修为提升，更关键的是寿元再度大幅延续。
从最初入宗时仅剩的半年残命，硬生生延续至数年之久。
对旁人而言，百岁修仙是逆天绝境。
对他而言，每一次稳步突破，都是从死神手中抢夺一线生机。
稳固完境界，他收敛所有气息，将剩余两枚极品清风灵果妥善收好，作为后续修行底牌。
推开洞口遮挡，天光已然偏西，秘境三日试炼已然过半。
外围与中层的零碎机缘，基本已被他搜刮干净。
想要继续提升、积攒足够底蕴、争夺更大造化，唯有踏入秘境最核心的云雾幽谷。
那里是整座青峦秘境灵气最浓郁、机缘最丰厚的地方，同样也是凶险最盛、天骄云集、厮杀最惨烈的战场。
外门第一天才林辰，其余三名半步筑基的九层顶尖弟子，尽数汇聚核心幽谷。
无数高阶灵药、上古残宝、秘境本源造化，全部集中在那片区域。
寻常弟子畏其凶险、惧天骄威势，不敢靠近。
他起步太晚、寿元太短、底蕴太薄，普通零碎机缘早已满足不了他续命修行的需求。
想要逆天改命、稳住仙途、延续生机，他必须踏入纷争中心，争抢最好的造化。
他抬眸望向远处云雾缭绕、灵气冲天的幽谷深处，眸光沉静坚定。
旁人争天骄荣光、争宗门名次、争一时风光。
他只争一线寿元、争一条暮年仙路、争一个逆天未来。
一道白发佝偻的身影，再度踏入密林阴影，朝着秘境核心，稳步前行。
属于百岁老者的低调逆袭，即将在核心幽谷，悄然绽放。

Volume 1 Chapter 25 Entering the third level of Qi refining in old age (Page 1)
Su Xuanchen picked up a top quality Qingfeng Spirit Fruit, opened his mouth and swallowed it.
In an instant, the sweet and moist medicinal power melted away, flowing along the meridians, limbs and bones, and infiltrating the spiritual sea of ​​dantian.
Unlike the Red Blood Spirit Fruit, which specializes in nourishing physical energy and blood, the medicinal power of the Qingfeng Spirit Fruit is better at sorting out the meridians, purifying spiritual power, and washing away impurities from practice.
Wisps of pure medicinal power slowly washed away the spiritual power he had accumulated over many days of practice.
All the remaining miscellaneous power accumulated from the previous fights in the secret realm, battles with monsters, and spiritual milk nourishment have been wiped away.
His meridians were continuously widened, strengthened, and warmed, and the slight tightness left by his old age practice completely disappeared.
Within the dantian, the spiritual power of the Tianling Root becomes increasingly pure, thick, and condensed.
Layer after layer is steadily stacked up, slowly piled up, never manic impact, only steadily polishing the foundation of the realm.
Su Xuanchen always closed his eyes and concentrated, keeping his mind steady and controlling the flow rate of the medicine.
When cultivating immortality in your later years, the foundation is more important than anything else. The realm can be slow, but the background must not be vain.
He did not rush for quick success and breakthrough, but relied on the excellent medicinal power of the top-grade spiritual fruit to polish his body's meridians and spiritual power over and over again.
Time passed slowly, and half an hour passed quietly.
The spiritual barrier that had been stuck on the second level of Qi Refining for a long time was completely loosened and shattered under the nourishment of the extremely pure medicinal power!
There was no spiritual light reaching the sky, no vision leaked, and no breakthrough at all.
All the breath was firmly locked within his body, making it impossible for outsiders to detect it.
Only he himself knows that at this moment, he has completed an all-round transformation.
The meridians are wider, the spiritual power is purer, the body is more stable, and the vitality is more abundant.
The aura of decay and death that had lingered around him for hundreds of years had mostly dissipated again.
The originally rickety back was straightened unnoticeably to the naked eye, the gray hair had a faint sheen, and the cloudy eyes were completely clear, deep and calm.
After the breakthrough, he did not stop practicing and continued to sit firmly in the cave, spending an entire hour to stabilize his new realm.
The first three levels of Qi Refining were polished to perfection and stability, and every ray of spiritual power was condensed to the extreme without any flaw.
This breakthrough not only brought Su Xuanchen an improvement in his cultivation, but more importantly, his longevity was greatly extended again.
The half-year life left when he first joined the sect suddenly extended to several years.
To others, cultivating immortality at the age of 100 is a desperate situation.
For him, every steady breakthrough is a glimmer of life snatched from the hands of death.
After stabilizing his realm, he restrained all his aura and put away the remaining two top-quality Qingfeng Spirit Fruits as trump cards for subsequent training.
After pushing open the cave entrance to cover, the skylight has turned to the west, and the three-day trial in the secret realm is already halfway through.
He has basically scooped up all the scattered opportunities at the periphery and middle level.
If you want to continue to improve, accumulate enough foundation, and strive for greater fortune, you can only step into the cloud and mist valley at the core of the secret realm.
It is the place with the strongest aura and the richest opportunities in the entire Qingluan Secret Realm. It is also the most dangerous battlefield, where geniuses gather, and the fights are the most brutal.
Lin Chen, the first genius of the outer sect, and the other three top ninth-level disciples who had half-stepped the foundation, all gathered in the core valley.
Countless high-level elixirs, ancient relics, and secret creations are all concentrated in that area.
Ordinary disciples are afraid of its danger and power, and dare not approach it.
He started too late, his lifespan was too short, and his foundation was too weak. Ordinary scattered opportunities could no longer meet his needs to continue practicing.
If he wants to change his fate, stabilize his path to immortality, and continue his vitality, he must step into the center of the dispute and fight for the best fortune.
He raised his eyes and looked into the depths of the valley shrouded in clouds and mist, filled with soaring aura, his eyes calm and firm.
Others compete for the glory of the genius, the ranking of the sect, and the glory of the moment.
He only fights for a ray of longevity, a path to immortality in his old age, and a future that defies the will of heaven.
A hunched figure with white hair stepped into the shadows of the dense forest again, heading steadily towards the core of the secret realm.
A low-key counterattack belonging to a centenarian is about to bloom quietly in the core valley.
